name: Salesloft
description: Access your live Salesloft data directly inside Claude. Ask about deals, accounts, contacts, conversations, and pipeline status — and get answers grounded in real engagement data, call transcripts, and deal activity. Secured with OAuth 2.0 and role-scoped permissions so you only see your own data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Salesloft to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Salesloft to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.salesloft.com/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Salesloft MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Salesloft lists 14 MCP tools, including account_by_id, conversation_by_id, conversation_recording_by_id, conversation_transcript_by_id, current_team, current_user, opportunity_by_id, person_by_id, search_accounts, search_conversations, search_opportunities, and search_people.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Salesloft?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Salesloft in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Salesloft requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Salesloft is developed by Salesloft. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
